results.title: Rafi bags two golds, breaks championship record in Thailand
results.description: Bangladesh swimmer Samiul Islam Rafi won two gold medals and a bronze at the 2026 Thailand Age Group Swimming Championships, according to a press release on Sunday.

results.title: Steelers going back-to-back padded training camp practices
results.description: This week the Pittsburgh Steelers are planning to get to work and follow up a big preseason win with back-to-back padded practices in preparation for the next game, if the weather allows.
